high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from a news website. The headline reads: "Rath Yatra scare in Ahmedabad: Elephant runs amok near Khadia, tranquilised and isolated; 17 others continue on route." The story is by Parth Shastri and was published 5 hours ago. The main content of the article describes an incident where a male elephant from an 18-elephant procession in the Rath Yatra celebrations went out of control near Desai Ni Pol in Khadia on Friday morning. This caused a brief scare among onlookers. The article mentions that the elephant was tranquilized
